description: Delegate the stats --help branch entirely to dispatchStats, removing the duplicated STATS_HELP print in the 'stats' switch case.

userStories.title: Delegate stats --help to dispatchStats
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the 'stats' switch case to stop printing STATS_HELP itself and delegate the help branch to dispatchStats, so the help text has a single source of truth (no dead duplicate write) while runtime output stays byte-for-byte identical.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'stats' switch case in index.ts no longer writes STATS_HELP itself; the case body reduces to parsing args, the null guard, and `return dispatchStats(parsed)`, so the help branch is handled solely by dispatchStats. [oracle: file-assert ! sed -n '/case .stats.: {/,/^\t\tcase /p' index.ts | grep -q 'process.stdout.write(STATS_HELP)']

dispatchStats still owns the help path (its `if (parsed.help)` write of STATS_HELP is untouched). [oracle: file-assert sed -n '/export function dispatchStats/,/^}/p' index.ts | grep -q 'process.stdout.write(STATS_HELP)']
`bun index.ts stats --help` prints the stats help exactly once (usage line rendered once, not duplicated). [oracle: test $(bun index.ts stats --help | grep -c 'cam stats tokens') -eq 1]

The rendered help content is unchanged: the tagline and behaviour section still appear. [oracle: bun index.ts stats --help | grep -q 'Per-issue token spend from the event log' && bun index.ts stats --help | grep -q 'unattributed spend']
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine is green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single file: index.ts. The duplicated help handling lives in the `case 'stats':` block (around index.ts:2808-2816): delete the `if (parsed.help) { process.stdout.write(STATS_HELP); return 0; }` guard (3 lines) so the block falls straight through to `return dispatchStats(parsed)`. dispatchStats (index.ts:2023) already handles `parsed.help` by writing STATS_HELP and returning 0, so runtime output is identical. Do NOT change dispatchStats or the STATS_HELP definition (index.ts:961). GOTCHA (auditor finding #1): STATS_HELP is built via renderHelp, which emits 'Usage' as a section heading with the value 'cam stats tokens' on a separate indented line, so the literal string 'Usage: cam stats' NEVER appears in the output (grep for it returns 0); use 'cam stats tokens' or the tagline for count/content oracles. GOTCHA (auditor finding #2): use the pattern-anchored `! sed ... | grep -q` absence idiom (not `grep -qv`, which is platform-dependent under -q, and not hardcoded line numbers, which shift when the 3-line guard is deleted). Existing stats dispatch tests live in test/commands/stats.test.ts; confirm they still pass.
